propositions: Agents preferentially copy locally-salient four-character ticket prefixes instead of user-friendly aliases because summary_compute returns the caller-supplied token as ticket_id but omits the resolved state.alias field.
The summary schema, CLI JSON, library, and MCP contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making the compact prefix the most salient available identifier for agent selection.

Adding the exact resolved alias as an additive field to summary results, paired with affirmative agent guidance to prefer aliases in tracker commands and reserve canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts, produces 25/25 alias selection without breaking canonical-trailer contracts.

Resolver ergonomics and fail-closed ambiguity handling are not the root cause; the defect is incomplete implementation of the approved WS5 agent-fitness intent that required create/show parity by exposing both id and alias to eliminate unnecessary second queries.
